data.action: 双手背在身后微微倾身回眸甜笑，列车驶过的风吹动发丝与毛衣领口
data.camera: medium shot, eye-level, clear station portrait
data.description: 【一之濑明日奈 · 都会站台的甜美回眸】夜晚明亮的基沃托斯现代化地下铁站台，列车刚刚呼啸而过带起微风。明日奈站在安全黄线内，双手背在身后微微倾身。宽松毛衣下滑露出雪白香肩，金色长发如波浪般翻涌。她看着刚刚赶来汇合的老师，眼睛弯成了月牙，露出毫不设防的治愈甜笑——「老师！太好啦，还以为今天见不到你了呢~」
data.lighting: 站台冷白色高照度灯光与指示牌亮白灯箱
data.location: 现代化地下铁整洁明亮站台
data.promptProse: Asuna waits inside the subway platform's safety line, hands behind her back, leaning slightly toward the arriving teacher with an open smile. Her ivory ribbed sweater, denim skirt and golden hair shift in the breeze from a passing train. The eye-level medium view follows platform tiles into the station beyond. Cool-white lights illuminate her face and sweater stitches, while sign lightboxes add pale reflections along nearby metal edges.
data.title: 一之濑明日奈 · 都会站台的甜美回眸
